part.name: OD-W03
part.what_it_is: Water tank valve cover (translucent moulded plastic): stadium flange with skirt, two valve cups with conical shoulders and single-barb hose nipples, a middle boss with a top hole, four ribs, and an L-shaped ear with a fixing hole at each end.

method_summary: Intake: full-resolution scan (owner-confirmed), nothing removed; datum = flange top face (z = 0), origin = midpoint of the two cup axes, +X from cup A to cup B (align.py feature_line clock).

Measure: meridian profiles, binned-median line fits, IRLS circles and open-boundary loops on the aligned scan; per-cup and per-ear values kept where they differ beyond noise; tops re-measured as cones after a builder self-check.

Rebuild: build123d, revolved cup and boss meridians, stadium flange extrude, planar ribs, tapered tab prisms and slot lugs, one cut-tool set for the hollow shell (owner decision); 5 fillets logged, all at target.
Verify: independent agent, own ICP, two-way full-res deviation under regime {{gate:regime.name}}; verdict BAND_NOT_MET, accepted by the owner.

limitations.text: No calipers: tier1 partial, none of the requested dimensions is calipered (ABSENT, not passed), and the absolute scale is not caliper-verified. Every size is scan-derived.
limitations.rerun_trigger: Any caliper reading in input/MEASUREMENTS.md (ENV-X / ENV-Y first, for scale) triggers a re-run of verify.

limitations.text: Interior, underside, wall thickness ({{params:wall_t.value}} mm), barb-bore and boss-hole depths are assumed (owner decision: hollow shell), not measured. The observable CAD->scan miss comes almost entirely from these unscanned surfaces.
limitations.rerun_trigger: A scan of the underside/interior or a wall-thickness caliper reading triggers a rebuild and re-run.

limitations.text: The gate registration is a QA workaround (qa/scripts/tier2_icp_signed.py, signed normal agreement). The shipped tier2_icp.py paired the invented inner walls with the outer skin and converged to a shifted frame; that run is kept and reported (qa/deviation_run1.json).
limitations.rerun_trigger: tier2_icp.py fixed to use signed normal agreement triggers a re-run of the gate.

limitations.text: Scan->CAD max passes only masked: M1 (bridging film across the barb A bore mouth) and M2 (junk facets at the tab/lug junction). Unmasked max is {{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.max}} mm. Scan->CAD p95 misses the band masked ({{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad_masked.p95}}) and unmasked ({{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.p95}}).
limitations.rerun_trigger: A rescan of the barb tips and ear junctions (matt spray) triggers an unmasked re-run.

limitations.text: The datum audit ran through qa/scripts/datum_audit_pair.py, because datum_audit.py has no two-feature midpoint origin or feature_line clock; it reuses datum_audit.py's own fit functions.
limitations.rerun_trigger: datum_audit.py gains circle-pair origin and feature_line clock support: re-run the audit.

limitations.text: Overlays are drawn in the builder's datum frame (overlay.py has no registration option); the ICP correction is below what the panels resolve.
limitations.rerun_trigger: A registration correction larger than the panel resolution: regenerate the overlays in the ICP frame.

limitations.text: Functional-interface zones Z1-Z4 are reported, not gated (baseline-skill has no interface band); the Z2/Z4 CAD->scan zone numbers include invented bore and cavity walls.
limitations.rerun_trigger: A regime with an interface band declared at intake triggers a re-run.

limitations.text: Known fixable residuals left in the model by the owner's accept-now decision: cup B upper wall reads short of the scan, and the skirt's lower edge (scan inside the CAD) is either a real draft or scan curl the data cannot separate.
limitations.rerun_trigger: Owner asks for a REVISE loop, or a caliper reading on cup B / the skirt, triggers a measure-route loop 2.

assumptions.text: Hollow moulded shell: cups and boss open from below, plate/skirt/cup walls at the assumed thickness, barb bores through into the cup cavities, boss hole through into its cavity.
Lug underside flat at the lowest point where the scan saw the lug side walls (the underside itself is not scanned).
Units assumed mm; no scale correction applied.

fit_for: visual / outer-envelope model of the part (the outer skin follows the full-resolution scan)
a starting CAD for a caliper-verified revision
not_fit_for: tooling or manufacture release until calipered and the underside is captured
hose, seal or fixing-hole fit decisions (no dimension is caliper-verified; interior invented)
